subject: Renewal + EU onramp plan with APAC standby capacity
messages:
From: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tbennett@clearcarehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Hi Grace,

We're starting renewal discussions internally and want to align on two asks we need included in the next contract term:

1) EU onramp: ClearCare is requiring a primary EU residency for patient-facing inference by Q4 2026. We'd like Redwood to host a primary EU node (data residency) and a plan for onboarding (SOW + cutover windows).

2) APAC standby: For our APAC pilot customers, we need an APAC standby region (failover/burst only) with predictable cold-standby capacity and a defined failover playbook — we won't route steady traffic there initially, but we need a capacity commitment for immediate bumping during promotions.

We've attached an internal forecast (capacity estimates) and would like a commercial change to the renewal to cover the above: separate residency addendum + firm standby capacity at a monthly reserved rate. Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk the SOW and commercial options?

Thanks,
Lena
Head of Cloud Operations
ClearCare Health

Attachment: clearcare-capacity-forecast-2026.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear summary and the forecast, helpful. We can definitely support an EU primary residency plus an APAC standby model. Proposed immediate next steps:

- Internal scoping call with our delivery + infra (I copied Neha) to confirm timeline and migration cutover windows.
- Commercial options: reserved EU node (monthly commit) vs. staged ramp + standby reserved capacity for APAC. I'll loop in Vivek to propose seat & pricing tiers.
- I'll draft a SOW addendum (EU onramp) and a short appendix that describes APAC standby terms and failover runbook.

Are you available Mon 7/6 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 7/7 14:00-14:30 PT?

—Grace
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-eu-onramp-sow-v1.pdf (draft outline)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Great summary — pricing note for the sync:

- EU primary residency: propose a 12-month reserved node at a discounted committed rate (we can tier by baseline TPS and peak buffer).
- APAC standby: recommend a small reserved standby pool (charged at 40% of active rate) with an agreed instant-burst SLA and warm-up time (ETA ~15 mins for scaled throughput).
- Term ask: if ClearCare commits to a 12-month EU residency + 6-month notice for decommission, we can include a 10% credit toward migration costs and waive one onboarding consulting day.

I'll bring a pricing sheet to the call. Grace — can you capture the migration cutover constraints from their forecast so we size the baseline?

—Vivek
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 17:14:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Hi Lena — thanks for the forecast. A few technical constraints / questions from delivery: 

- Cutover windows: we prefer three 2-hour maintenance windows during low usage for prefix cache warm-up and data sync. Please confirm preferred dates in Oct/Nov.
- Data residency: do you want customer data-at-rest in EU only, or dual-write with US for backup? We need to know to size storage and replication.
- APAC standby: please confirm RPS escalation policy (e.g., up to 3x baseline) and whether there are cold-start tolerances for route propagation.

If you can provide the preferred cutover weeks, we'll include precise migration runbook steps in the SOW.

Thanks — Neha
Senior Delivery Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tbennett@clearcarehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 08:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Hi everyone — thanks for the quick responses. Quick answers:

- Cutover windows: prefer week of Oct 18 (EU local maintenance window Tue/Wed nights CET). We'll confirm exact dates by 7/31.
- Data residency: EU-only at-rest for patient inference, replicate logs (anonymized) to US for analytics. No dual-write of PII.
- APAC standby: baseline RPS estimate in the attached workbook — standby should support up to 4x baseline for the first 2 hours of a campaign; warm-up tolerance: 10–20 minutes acceptable.

We can take the 7/6 or 7/7 call — 7/6 10:00 PT works for me.

Lena
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena.hoffman@clearcarehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — EU launch + APAC standby ask

Thanks all — great call today. Recap and agreed next steps (action owners):

1) Commercial: Vivek to send two options by 7/12 — (A) 12-month EU reserved node + APAC standby at 40% reserved rate; (B) staged 6→12 month ramp with lower up-front commit. (Vivek)
2) SOW: Neha to update redwood-eu-onramp-sow-v1.pdf with cutover runbook (include the three 2-hour windows) and the APAC standby appendix. SOW draft by 7/19. (Neha)
3) Legal/Procurement: Monica to coordinate term amendment and redline the term language for EU residency (no PII dual-write) and standby billing. (Monica)
4) Customer: Lena to confirm exact cutover dates by 7/31 and provide final capacity matrix if any numbers change. (Lena)

I've attached the draft term amendment we discussed. Once Vivek sends pricing, Monica and ClearCare procurement can agree on the final amendment and we can route DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood-term-amendment-draft.docx, redwood-eu-onramp-sow-v1.pdf

Best — Grace
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
